culprit_citations.quoted_text: Total Debt & Equity Investments (7) | 114.4% | fair value 249,694,433

findings.detail: Vehicle-type classification assigns PRIVATE_CREDIT although source-schedule equity fair value of 162,797,111 materially exceeds debt fair value of 86,897,322.

rationale: Class 3 anchor-first review. The March 31, 2026 source schedule reports debt fair value of 86,897,322, equity fair value of 162,797,111, and combined debt-and-equity fair value of 249,694,433. Equity is 65.2% of debt plus equity and is nearly 1.9 times debt. Thus the validation flag correctly identifies a real strategy classification error: PRIVATE_CREDIT was assigned from BDC vehicle type without looking through to the equity-dominant investment mix. Short-term investments are separately labeled and do not reverse the debt-versus-equity conclusion.
